game.title: Blockmancer
game.subtitle: Daily run · same pieces for everyone
game.practiceSubtitle: Practice · a new run every time

tutorial.drag: Drag a piece onto the board
tutorial.clear: Fill a row to clear it
tutorial.pick: Pick your first joker — they work in pairs

offers.startSubtitle: Jokers work in pairs. You pick one more after every round, so plan your build.
offers.nextRound: Pick a joker. Next: round $index · $target pts.

nextBoss.rubble: Pick a joker. Next: Boss · $target pts with stones.
nextBoss.gravity: Pick a joker. Next: Boss · $target pts, and pieces fall.
nextBoss.fog: Pick a joker. Next: Boss · $target pts in the fog.
nextBoss.tide: Pick a joker. Next: Boss · $target pts as the tide rises.
nextBoss.mirror: Pick a joker. Next: Boss · $target pts in the mirror.

bossCard.title: The $world boss
bossCard.rubble: The boss starts with stones already on the board.
bossCard.gravity: In this boss, every piece falls as far down as it can.
bossCard.fog: Fog hides the board. Fill next to it to see what's underneath.
bossCard.tide: Every new tray, the tide rises one row. Don't let it push your blocks off the top.

lost.reviveUnavailable: No ad to revive with right now

unlocks.label: Unlocked
unlocks.jokersNote: These jokers can now turn up in your runs.

description(param=stones).one: +$chips chips for each stone cleared. $stones extra stone every round.
description(param=stones).other: +$chips chips for each stone cleared. $stones extra stones every round.

combo.name: Combo King
combo.description: +$mult mult for every clearing move in a row.

patience.name: Patience
patience.description: Each move without a clear stores +$mult mult for your next clear.

precision.name: Precision
precision.description: +$mult mult when a piece of up to $size cells completes a line.

collector.name: Collector
collector.description: +$mult mult on every clear for every two jokers you own.

twin.name: Twin Lines
twin.description: ×$factor mult when you clear $lines or more lines at once.

column.name: Column Hunter
column.description: ×$factor mult when your move clears a column.

heavy.name: Heavyweight
heavy.description: ×$factor mult when a piece of $size+ cells completes a line.

sweep.name: Clean Sweep
sweep.description: +$points points when the board becomes completely empty.

description(param=stones).one: Every clear drops a new stone on a random empty cell.
description(param=stones).other: Every clear drops $stones new stones on random empty cells.

bigbox.name: Big Box
bigbox.description: Pieces of $size+ cells show up $factor× more often.

tiny.name: Tiny Tools
tiny.description: Pieces of up to $size cells show up $factor× more often.

saver.name: Saver
saver.description: Each unused piece when you beat a round gives +$points run points.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.description: +$mult mult when your move clears the bottom row.

description(param=rows).one: +$chips chips for each filled cell left in the bottom row after a clear.
description(param=rows).other: +$chips chips for each filled cell left in the bottom $rows rows after a clear.

fullhouse.name: Full House
fullhouse.description: +$mult mult for every $cells occupied cells, stones included, as your piece lands.

brink.name: On the Brink
brink.description: ×$factor mult when $cells or more cells are occupied, stones included, as your piece lands.

finisher.name: Finisher
finisher.description: ×$factor mult when you play the last piece in your tray.

hattrick.name: Hat Trick
hattrick.description: +$points points when each of the $pieces pieces of a full tray clears a line.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.description: Stones and fog beside a cleared line are cleared with it.

ember.name: Ember
ember.description: +$mult mult on every clear; ×$factor mult instead when your move clears a stone or a fog cell.

sprinter.name: Sprinter
sprinter.description: +$mult mult when the first piece of a fresh tray clears a line.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.description: +$mult mult on every clear for each tray in a row whose first piece cleared a line.

symmetry.name: Symmetry
symmetry.description: +$mult mult when your clear leaves the board mirror-symmetric, and not empty.

prism.name: Prism
prism.description: +$chips chips for each filled cell or stone whose mirror cell is one too, after a clear.

push.channelDescription: News and messages from the app.

reminder.channelDescription: A reminder when today's daily run is ready.

streakCount.title: 🔥 ${n}-day streak!
streakCount.body: Don't break it now — today's run is waiting.

streakFire.title: 🔥 Keep the fire going
streakFire.body: Day $n of your streak. One run keeps it alive.

boardReady.title: 🧩 Today's board is ready
boardReady.body: Same seed for everyone. How far can you go?

newDaily.title: 🏆 New daily run
newDaily.body: Fresh pieces, fresh leaderboard. Claim the top spot.

jokersRestless.title: 🃏 Your jokers are restless
jokersRestless.body: Find a pair, chain the combos, beat today's score.

comboTime.title: 💥 Combo time
comboTime.body: Clear two lines at once and watch that mult climb.

fiveMinutes.title: ⚡ 5 minutes, one run
fiveMinutes.body: Today's daily run fits in a coffee break.

beatYesterday.title: 🎯 Beat yesterday's you
beatYesterday.body: A new seed, a new chance at your best score.

boardReset.title: ✨ The daily board just reset
boardReset.body: Everyone starts from zero. Get there first.

blocksFalling.title: 🧱 Blocks are falling into place
blocksFalling.body: Today's run is live. Show them how it's done.

comeback.title: 👋 We saved your spot
comeback.body: A new daily run is waiting — your jokers missed you.

complete.title: Every world complete
complete.body: Every boss is beaten: all $count worlds are yours.

resume.title: Continue run
resume.subtitle: Pick up where you left off

bossRule.rubble: The boss starts with stones on the board.
bossRule.fog: Fog hides cells. Fill next to it to see what's underneath.
bossRule.tide: Every new tray, the tide rises one row. Don't let it push your blocks off the top.
bossRule.gravity: In the boss round, every piece falls to the bottom.

sheet.lockedHint: Beat the previous boss to unlock

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.unavailableMessage: We couldn't open a mail app. Write to us at $address.

testStats.title: Share test stats
testStats.unavailableMessage: The share sheet didn't open. Try again in a moment.

reset.title: Reset progress
reset.confirmMessage: This erases your stars, the worlds and jokers you unlocked, your best scores and daily streak, the Spellbook's stats and the run in progress. Your settings and purchases stay. This can't be undone.

removeAds.title: Remove ads
removeAds.ownedLabel: Ads removed, purchased: no ads between runs, and revives without a video
removeAds.unavailableMessage: The store couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.

restore.title: Restore purchases
restore.restoredMessage: Ads are removed on this device, and revives need no video.
restore.noneMessage: No purchase was found for this store account.
restore.unreachableMessage: The store couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.

required.title: Update required
required.body: This version of Blockmancer is no longer supported. Update to keep playing; your progress is kept.
